title: Explicitly Aligned Multi-View Breast Cancer Risk Prediction from Variable-Length Screening Histories
abstract: arXiv:2610.16329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate breast cancer risk prediction from screening mammography is essential for improved risk stratification and personalized screening. It can benefit from both temporal breast tissue changes across longitudinal examinations and complementary anatomical information from craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views. Leveraging longitudinal information requires identifying corresponding tissue regions across examinations, yet most approaches rely on implicit feature alignment without explicitly enforcing spatial consistency. Recent work has demonstrated the benefits of explicit temporal alignment; however, existing methods model each view independently, preventing them from exploiting complementary CC and MLO information. Furthermore, explicit approaches have been limited to a single prior examination. translated_title: 基于显式对齐的多视角乳腺癌风险预测：利用可变长度的筛查历史
translated_abstract: 从筛查乳腺X光摄影中进行准确的乳腺癌风险预测，对于改善风险分层和个性化筛查至关重要。这一预测既可以受益于纵向检查中乳腺组织随时间的变化，也可以受益于头尾位（CC）和内外斜位（MLO）两个视角提供的互补解剖信息。利用纵向信息需要识别跨检查的对应组织区域，然而大多数方法依赖于隐式特征对齐，而没有显式地保证空间一致性。最近的研究已经证明了显式时间对齐的好处；然而，现有方法对每个视角独立建模，无法利用CC和MLO视图之间的互补信息。此外，显式对齐方法此前仅限于使用单次既往检查。为了填补这些空白，我们提出了FlexLMV-Net（github.com/sot176/FlexLMV-Net），一个按乳腺（breast-wise）组织的纵向多视角框架，它联合……
tldr: 提出了FlexLMV-Net框架，通过显式时空对齐联合建模可变长度筛查历史中的纵向组织变化与CC/MLO多视角互补信息，从而实现更准确的乳腺癌风险预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes FlexLMV-Net, a breast-wise longitudinal multi-view framework that explicitly aligns tissue regions across variable-length screening histories while jointly exploiting complementary CC and MLO view information for improved breast cancer risk prediction.
